issue: lines 3–4 are a bare list of names (ब्रह्मा हरिहर शंकर रेवा / शिव हरि शंकर रुद्री पालन्ती); रुद्री is unclear.
our reading: Revā is identified with Brahmā, Hari, Hara and Śaṅkara, and with Śiva, Hari, Śaṅkara and Rudrāṇī; she sustains
alternatives: the gods named worship Revā; रुद्री = Rudra's daughter (the Narmadā, held to be born of Śiva)

issue: पदचण्डी and पदवन्ती are not dictionary words; and ‘नारद शारद तुम वरदायक’ has no verb or case ending, so Nārada and Śāradā may be those she grants boons to or those who praise her.
our reading: you grant boons to Nārada and Śāradā; पद + चण्डी: holding the rank of Caṇḍī; पद + वन्दिता: whose feet are worshipped
alternatives: Nārada and Śāradā (sing that) you are the giver of boons; पदचण्डी: Caṇḍī at whose feet (all bow); पदवन्ती: who has attained the (highest) state

issue: धूमक is not in Platts or MW.
our reading: धूम, pomp: she rides her mount in splendour

issue: सुरमण्डल, तोड़ीतान, तुरड़ड़ and सुरवन्ती are musical words and sound syllables.
our reading: svaramaṇḍala (instrument); tāns in rāga Toḍī; the sound of the instruments; melodious
alternatives: सुरमण्डल = the assembly of the gods; सुरवन्ती = worshipped by the gods; तोड़ीतान = tān toṛnā, breaking into a tān

issue: the sentence's subject and verb are split over four lines; who repeats Hari is not said, and भजत could make Śivānanda the signature (‘sings Śivānanda Svāmī’).
our reading: those who read and sing the āratī, repeating Hari's name, gain the fruit desired; Śivānanda Svāmī sings it in worship
alternatives: Śivānanda Svāmī says: those who repeat Hari's name gain the fruit desired
